title: [plan] Marble Mayhem
body:
### What is your game called?

Marble Mayhem

### In one sentence, what do players do together?

Up to four marbles race down a twisty track and knock each other off the edges.

### How many people play at once?

2 to 4

### How long is one game?

under 5 minutes

### Does anyone gain by cheating?

no, it's for fun

### Does the world remember between games?

no, every game starts fresh

### Do players see different things?

no, everyone sees the same board

### Where do people play?

in a browser tab

### May AI agents play it too?

not sure yet

### Do you want to sell it?

sell copies

### If you sell it, what does a copy cost, in dollars?

4.99

### What do you have already?

- [ ] nothing yet
- [ ] some code
- [X] art
- [ ] a GitHub repo

### Anything else Claude should know?

_No response_
